steps.title: Lay down a rug
steps.sub: Pinch it on the tray. It lands on your floor at its true size.

steps.title: Sofa against the wall
steps.sub: Pinch and drag it across the floor, then turn it to face the TV.

steps.title: Coffee table in front
steps.sub: Centred on the rug, between the sofa and the screen.

steps.title: An armchair by the window
steps.sub: Real dimensions, so you see the walkway that’s left.

steps.title: Green in the corner
steps.sub: Fill the empty spots the way you would at home.

steps.title: Storage by the door
steps.sub: A chest of drawers with real joints, sized to the wall.

steps.title: Restyle the whole room
steps.sub: Japandi. Industrial. Cyberpunk. One pinch each.
